rules.title: Broker fee paid only by the party that hired the broker
rules.requirement: A licensed broker or salesperson may contract with either the prospective tenant or the landlord (or landlord's agent), but not both. Any broker fee may be paid only by the party that originally hired the broker, so tenants cannot be charged a landlord-hired broker's fee.
rules.key_value: Fee paid only by the party who engaged the broker
rules.coverage_conditions: Rental residential real property in Massachusetts where a licensed real estate broker or salesperson is engaged to find a tenant or a rental.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Applies only where a licensed broker or salesperson is involved in the rental transaction.

rules.citation: M.G.L. c. 112, § 87DDD½, as amended by St. 2025, c. 9, § 43
rules.quoted_span: Any fee shall only be paid by the party, lessor or tenant who originally engaged and entered into a contract with the licensed broker or salesperson.
rules.conflict_note: The page shows the prior text (effective until August 1, 2025) and the amended text (effective August 1, 2025, per St. 2025, c. 9, § 136). As of 2026-10-01 the amended text governs.
